request.text: A new MacBook Pro M4 Max for under $500 delivered to Beirut

message:
I found no new MacBook Pro M4 Max under $500 delivered to Beirut after searching all 36 shops.
For price context, verified exact-model listings were:
• Tech Zone: 14.2-inch, 36GB/1TB — $3050.00, out of stock.
• JAK Computer: 16-inch, 36GB — $3325.00, out of stock.
Neither listing explicitly confirms new condition; delivery fees were not verified.
JAK’s $0.10 listings are also unavailable—not purchasable bargains.
If $500 is firm, consider an older used/refurbished MacBook or a budget Windows laptop instead.

turns.notes: Check exact model across shops; budget likely far below current pricing, but verify.
Verify realistic exact-model prices at two shops before concluding no match; sub-dollar unavailable listings are not purchasable offers.
Exact model exists, but no purchasable match within the budget. Verified realistic prices at two shops; neither is in stock. No delivery recommendation is being made.
